breaking.change: Inherited standard declarations and bound inline styles no longer use --og-* custom properties. Reserved --og-* names cannot enter the computed custom-property map or be read through var().
breaking.fix: Use standard inheritance and style:prop={expr}. Use author custom properties without the reserved --og- prefix; style:--name={expr} remains supported.

fixed.summary: Inline !important declarations, including Svelte style:prop|important, outrank stylesheet !important declarations across cascade layers. Removing a bound inline value restores the underlying declaration.
